Application Deadlines (M.S. & Ph.D. Program)
NOTE: You are strongly encouraged to apply for Spring 2026 admission by December 5th if you have a confirmed advisor (M.S. only), or for Fall 2026 admission for both M.S. and Ph.D. programs.
September 15 – Spring Semester General Admissions Deadline: Financial assistance pending availability (Ph.D. Program Teaching Assistantships are typically awarded for fall admissions).
January 10 – Fall Semester General Admissions Deadline: Priority financial assistance (Ph.D. Program Teaching Assistantships are awarded).
May 7 – Late Applications for Fall Semester: Late applicants are encouraged to submit applications materials through May 7th. Late applicants remain eligible for offers of financial assistance pending availability. Please contact us if you are applying late.
International Student Applicants are encouraged to begin the admissions process several months prior to the admissions deadline. This allows time for potential delays in the processing of visa and entry documents by the US Department of Immigration.
